subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The __________ purpose of the coaching was to identify the talented players.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"main"** refers to the most important or central part of something. (मुख्य) • **Example:** The **main** objective of the project is to improve community health. Hence, we can infer that the appropriate word to fill in the blank is **'main'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Mane** (अयाल): The long hair on the neck of a horse, lion, or other animal. • **Example:** The horse's **mane **was neatly braided for the show. • **Mean** (मतलब): To signify or intend something. • **Example:** What do you **mean** by that statement? • **Mine** (मेरा): Possessive form referring to something that belongs to the speaker. • **Example:** This book is **mine.** 41:Te04,
